subject: Retake smoke harness found intra-exam answer-collision failures in RP6/RP7
body: Ran new smoke harness (scripts/gp-retake-smoke.ps1) which executes verify-practice-exams.js for RP6 and RP7. Current result: RP6 299/309 (10 failures), RP7 327/339 (12 failures), all from unique-answer checks (Q pairs). Please review whether these are true collisions or validator false positives after latest content updates. If true, please patch RP6/RP7 and ping GP for rerun.
